last_change: Completed shared Obsidian organizational-memory integration in existing continuity start/end commands, project selection, evidence-backed source records, accumulated decisions, indexed/logged write-back, conflict detection, flock serialization, atomic writes and recovery. Installed versioned Quartz privacy policy and corrected its content symlink to the actual vault. No business notes were published.
verification: node --test scripts/continuity.test.mjs scripts/vault-memory.test.mjs scripts/quartz-privacy.test.mjs: 22 tests passed, 0 failed, including independent-process round trip, duplicate retries, concurrent writers, stale/external edits, nine interruption scenarios, secret exclusion and Quartz privacy policy.
node --check scripts/continuity.mjs, scripts/vault-memory.mjs and scripts/configure-quartz.mjs: passed.

Installed Quartz CLI fixture build: exit 0; 3 Markdown inputs, 2 filtered, 58 generated files; approved fixture marker present and private/unapproved/raw/attachment markers absent. Fixture inputs/output are under /tmp only.
Real startup loaded four selected organizational notes and returned a session ID. Actual reviewed end and fresh-process restoration are executed as the final acceptance step.
31 pre-existing unrelated repository paths retain their baseline contents. No auth, pricing, database, application UI or web serving configuration changed; those suites were not run.
Exploratory direct Quartz imports failed on SCSS/inline-script loading; supported Quartz CLI fixture build and TypeScript verification passed instead.
decisions: User-required preservation: retain approved Vulpine design identity, existing fonts and teal/obsidian tokens; this task changes no UI.
Implemented engineering choice: explicitly select relevant vault notes, store source-backed execution records and accumulate decisions without rewriting existing company/person/raw records.
Implemented concurrency contract: supported writers use the shared vault flock and session baselines; conflicting or interrupted external edits require explicit reconciliation.

Implemented privacy choice within authorized Quartz repair: require explicit publish approval, deny private/draft content and disable automatic attachment copying; preserve existing web access controls.
Retain command-based invocation; no universal agent hook, background synchronization or implicit owner/commercial approval is installed.
open_work: Preserve pre-existing staged tracker migration and other unrelated working-tree changes; reconcile with their owner before separate commits.
Obsidian UI and generic filesystem MCP editors must pause writes to managed records or adopt the shared lock; their final comparison/rename race cannot be excluded by advisory locking.
Vault backup policy, cross-host/network filesystem coordination and linked Git worktrees are not certified. No background lifecycle hook is installed.
Future project onboarding must select relevant notes in vault.json; no broad personal-record crawl is performed. Public attachments require a separately approved process.
next_action: Use continuity start for the next selected Vulpine task, retain its session ID, reconcile live drift and preserve approved design; after verified work submit an evidence-backed end handoff. Commit/push this integration after final review.
